jobs.explanation: Confirmed admission, then GET 404 Job not found. No terminal success payload was saved. Official Jobs schema says completed jobs are automatically cleaned up; no recovery/list endpoint for standalone PixMiniMax images is documented. Exact cause and completion status are unverified. Original POST barrier remains; any new generation needs a new recorded attempt.
